#==============================================================================
# ** Scene_Battle (part 4)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This class performs battle screen processing.
#==============================================================================

class Scene_Battle
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Start Main Phase
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def start_phase4
    # Shift to phase 4
    @phase = 4
    # Turn count
    $game_temp.battle_turn += 1
    # Search all battle event pages
    for index in 0...$data_troops[@troop_id].pages.size
      # Get event page
      page = $data_troops[@troop_id].pages[index]
      # If this page span is [turn]
      if page.span == 1
        # Clear action completed flags
        $game_temp.battle_event_flags[index] = false
      end
    end
    # Set actor as unselectable
    @actor_index = -1
    @active_battler = nil
    # Enable party command window
    @party_command_window.active = false
    @party_command_window.visible = false
    # Disable actor command window
    @actor_command_window.active = false
    @actor_command_window.visible = false
    # Set main phase flag
    $game_temp.battle_main_phase = true
    # Make enemy action
    for enemy in $game_troop.enemies
      enemy.make_action
    end
    # Make action orders
    make_action_orders
    # Shift to step 1
    @phase4_step = 1
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Make Action Orders
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def make_action_orders
    # Initialize @action_battlers array
    @action_battlers = []
    # Add enemy to @action_battlers array
    for enemy in $game_troop.enemies
      @action_battlers.push(enemy)
    end
    # Add actor to @action_battlers array
    for actor in $game_party.actors
      @action_battlers.push(actor)
    end
    # Decide action speed for all
    for battler in @action_battlers
      battler.make_action_speed
    end
    # Line up action speed in order from greatest to least
    @action_battlers.sort! {|a,b|
      b.current_action.speed - a.current_action.speed }
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4
    case @phase4_step
    when 1
      update_phase4_step1
    when 2
      update_phase4_step2
    when 3
      update_phase4_step3
    when 4
      update_phase4_step4
    when 5
      update_phase4_step5
    when 6
      update_phase4_step6
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase step 1 : action preparation)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4_step1
    # Hide help window
    @help_window.visible = false
    # Determine win/loss
    if judge
      # If won, or if lost : end method
      return
    end
    # If an action forcing battler doesn't exist
    if $game_temp.forcing_battler == nil
      # Set up battle event
      setup_battle_event
      # If battle event is running
      if $game_system.battle_interpreter.running?
        return
      end
    end
    # If an action forcing battler exists
    if $game_temp.forcing_battler != nil
      # Add to head, or move
      @action_battlers.delete($game_temp.forcing_battler)
      @action_battlers.unshift($game_temp.forcing_battler)
    end
    # If no actionless battlers exist (all have performed an action)
    if @action_battlers.size == 0
      # Start party command phase
      start_phase2
      return
    end
    # Initialize animation ID and common event ID
    @animation1_id = 0
    @animation2_id = 0
    @common_event_id = 0
    # Shift from head of actionless battlers
    @active_battler = @action_battlers.shift
    # If already removed from battle
    if @active_battler.index == nil
      return
    end
    # Slip damage
    if @active_battler.hp > 0 and @active_battler.slip_damage?
      @active_battler.slip_damage_effect
      @active_battler.damage_pop = true
    end
    # Natural removal of states
    @active_battler.remove_states_auto
    # Refresh status window
    @status_window.refresh
    # Shift to step 2
    @phase4_step = 2
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase step 2 : start action)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4_step2
    # If not a forcing action
    unless @active_battler.current_action.forcing
      # If restriction is [normal attack enemy] or [normal attack ally]
      if @active_battler.restriction == 2 or @active_battler.restriction == 3
        # Set attack as an action
        @active_battler.current_action.kind = 0
        @active_battler.current_action.basic = 0
      end
      # If restriction is [cannot perform action]
      if @active_battler.restriction == 4
        # Clear battler being forced into action
        $game_temp.forcing_battler = nil
        # Shift to step 1
        @phase4_step = 1
        return
      end
    end
    # Clear target battlers
    @target_battlers = []
    # Branch according to each action
    case @active_battler.current_action.kind
    when 0  # basic
      make_basic_action_result
    when 1  # skill
      make_skill_action_result
    when 2  # item
      make_item_action_result
    end
    # Shift to step 3
    if @phase4_step == 2
      @phase4_step = 3
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Make Basic Action Results
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def make_basic_action_result
    # If attack
    if @active_battler.current_action.basic == 0
      # Set anaimation ID
      @animation1_id = @active_battler.animation1_id
      @animation2_id = @active_battler.animation2_id
      # If action battler is enemy
      if @active_battler.is_a?(Game_Enemy)
        if @active_battler.restriction == 3
          target = $game_troop.random_target_enemy
        elsif @active_battler.restriction == 2
          target = $game_party.random_target_actor
        else
          index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
          target = $game_party.smooth_target_actor(index)
        end
      end
      # If action battler is actor
      if @active_battler.is_a?(Game_Actor)
        if @active_battler.restriction == 3
          target = $game_party.random_target_actor
        elsif @active_battler.restriction == 2
          target = $game_troop.random_target_enemy
        else
          index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
          target = $game_troop.smooth_target_enemy(index)
        end
      end
      # Set array of targeted battlers
      @target_battlers = [target]
      # Apply normal attack results
      for target in @target_battlers
        target.attack_effect(@active_battler)
      end
      return
    end
    # If guard
    if @active_battler.current_action.basic == 1
      # Display "Guard" in help window
      @help_window.set_text($data_system.words.guard, 1)
      return
    end
    # If escape
    if @active_battler.is_a?(Game_Enemy) and
       @active_battler.current_action.basic == 2
      # Display "Escape" in help window
      @help_window.set_text("Apartarse", 1)
      # Escape
      @active_battler.escape
      return
    end
    # If doing nothing
    if @active_battler.current_action.basic == 3
      # Clear battler being forced into action
      $game_temp.forcing_battler = nil
      # Shift to step 1
      @phase4_step = 1
      return
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Set Targeted Battler for Skill or Item
  #     scope : effect scope for skill or item
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def set_target_battlers(scope)
    # If battler performing action is enemy
    if @active_battler.is_a?(Game_Enemy)
      # Branch by effect scope
      case scope
      when 1  # single enemy
        index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
        @target_battlers.push($game_party.smooth_target_actor(index))
      when 2  # all enemies
        for actor in $game_party.actors
          if actor.exist?
            @target_battlers.push(actor)
          end
        end
      when 3  # single ally
        index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
        @target_battlers.push($game_troop.smooth_target_enemy(index))
      when 4  # all allies
        for enemy in $game_troop.enemies
          if enemy.exist?
            @target_battlers.push(enemy)
          end
        end
      when 5  # single ally (HP 0) 
        index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
        enemy = $game_troop.enemies[index]
        if enemy != nil and enemy.hp0?
          @target_battlers.push(enemy)
        end
      when 6  # all allies (HP 0) 
        for enemy in $game_troop.enemies
          if enemy != nil and enemy.hp0?
            @target_battlers.push(enemy)
          end
        end
      when 7  # user
        @target_battlers.push(@active_battler)
      end
    end
    # If battler performing action is actor
    if @active_battler.is_a?(Game_Actor)
      # Branch by effect scope
      case scope
      when 1  # single enemy
        index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
        @target_battlers.push($game_troop.smooth_target_enemy(index))
      when 2  # all enemies
        for enemy in $game_troop.enemies
          if enemy.exist?
            @target_battlers.push(enemy)
          end
        end
      when 3  # single ally
        index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
        @target_battlers.push($game_party.smooth_target_actor(index))
      when 4  # all allies
        for actor in $game_party.actors
          if actor.exist?
            @target_battlers.push(actor)
          end
        end
      when 5  # single ally (HP 0) 
        index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
        actor = $game_party.actors[index]
        if actor != nil and actor.hp0?
          @target_battlers.push(actor)
        end
      when 6  # all allies (HP 0) 
        for actor in $game_party.actors
          if actor != nil and actor.hp0?
            @target_battlers.push(actor)
          end
        end
      when 7  # user
        @target_battlers.push(@active_battler)
      end
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Make Skill Action Results
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def make_skill_action_result
    # Get skill
    @skill = $data_skills[@active_battler.current_action.skill_id]
    # If not a forcing action
    unless @active_battler.current_action.forcing
      # If unable to use due to SP running out
      unless @active_battler.skill_can_use?(@skill.id)
        # Clear battler being forced into action
        $game_temp.forcing_battler = nil
        # Shift to step 1
        @phase4_step = 1
        return
      end
    end
    # Use up SP
    @active_battler.sp -= @skill.sp_cost
    # Refresh status window
    @status_window.refresh
    # Show skill name on help window
    @help_window.set_text(@skill.name, 1)
    # Set animation ID
    @animation1_id = @skill.animation1_id
    @animation2_id = @skill.animation2_id
    # Set command event ID
    @common_event_id = @skill.common_event_id
    # Set target battlers
    set_target_battlers(@skill.scope)
    # Apply skill effect
    for target in @target_battlers
      target.skill_effect(@active_battler, @skill)
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Make Item Action Results
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def make_item_action_result
    # Get item
    @item = $data_items[@active_battler.current_action.item_id]
    # If unable to use due to items running out
    unless $game_party.item_can_use?(@item.id)
      # Shift to step 1
      @phase4_step = 1
      return
    end
    # If consumable
    if @item.consumable
      # Decrease used item by 1
      $game_party.lose_item(@item.id, 1)
    end
    # Display item name on help window
    @help_window.set_text(@item.name, 1)
    # Set animation ID
    @animation1_id = @item.animation1_id
    @animation2_id = @item.animation2_id
    # Set common event ID
    @common_event_id = @item.common_event_id
    # Decide on target
    index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
    target = $game_party.smooth_target_actor(index)
    # Set targeted battlers
    set_target_battlers(@item.scope)
    # Apply item effect
    for target in @target_battlers
      target.item_effect(@item)
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase step 3 : animation for action performer)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4_step3
    # Animation for action performer (if ID is 0, then white flash)
    if @animation1_id == 0
      @active_battler.white_flash = true
    else
      @active_battler.animation_id = @animation1_id
      @active_battler.animation_hit = true
    end
    # Shift to step 4
    @phase4_step = 4
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase step 4 : animation for target)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4_step4
    # Animation for target
    for target in @target_battlers
      target.animation_id = @animation2_id
      target.animation_hit = (target.damage != "Miss")
    end
    # Animation has at least 8 frames, regardless of its length
    @wait_count = 8
    # Shift to step 5
    @phase4_step = 5
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase step 5 : damage display)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4_step5
    # Hide help window
    @help_window.visible = false
    # Refresh status window
    @status_window.refresh
    # Display damage
    for target in @target_battlers
      if target.damage != nil
        target.damage_pop = true
      end
    end
    # Shift to step 6
    @phase4_step = 6
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase step 6 : refresh)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4_step6
    # Clear battler being forced into action
    $game_temp.forcing_battler = nil
    # If common event ID is valid
    if @common_event_id > 0
      # Set up event
      common_event = $data_common_events[@common_event_id]
      $game_system.battle_interpreter.setup(common_event.list, 0)
    end
    # Shift to step 1
    @phase4_step = 1
  end
end

# ** Scene_Name
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This class performs name input screen processing.
#==============================================================================

class Scene_Name
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Main Processing
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def main
    # Get actor
    @actor = $game_actors[$game_temp.name_actor_id]
    # Make windows
    @edit_window = Window_NameEdit.new(@actor, $game_temp.name_max_char)
    @input_window = Window_NameInput.new
    # Execute transition
    Graphics.transition
    # Main loop
    loop do
      # Update game screen
      Graphics.update
      # Update input information
      Input.update
      # Frame update
      update
      # Abort loop if screen is changed
      if $scene != self
        break
      end
    end
    # Prepare for transition
    Graphics.freeze
    # Dispose of windows
    @edit_window.dispose
    @input_window.dispose
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update
    # Update windows
    @edit_window.update
    @input_window.update
    # If B button was pressed
    if Input.repeat?(Input::B)
      # If cursor position is at 0
      if @edit_window.index == 0
        return
      end
      # Play cancel SE
      $game_system.se_play($data_system.cancel_se)
      # Delete text
      @edit_window.back
      return
    end
    # If C button was pressed
    if Input.trigger?(Input::C)
      # If cursor position is at [OK]
      if @input_window.character == nil
        # If name is empty
        if @edit_window.name == ""
          # Return to default name
          @edit_window.restore_default
          # If name is empty
          if @edit_window.name == ""
            # Play buzzer SE
            $game_system.se_play($data_system.buzzer_se)
            return
          end
          # Play decision SE
          $game_system.se_play($data_system.decision_se)
          return
        end
        # Change actor name
        @actor.name = @edit_window.name
        # Play decision SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.decision_se)
        # Switch to map screen
        $scene = Scene_Map.new
        return
      end
      # If cursor position is at maximum
      if @edit_window.index == $game_temp.name_max_char
        # Play buzzer SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.buzzer_se)
        return
      end
      # If text character is empty
      if @input_window.character == ""
        # Play buzzer SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.buzzer_se)
        return
      end
      # Play decision SE
      $game_system.se_play($data_system.decision_se)
      # Add text character
      @edit_window.add(@input_window.character)
      return
    end
  end
end

# ** Scene_Gameover
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This class performs game over screen processing.
#==============================================================================

class Scene_Gameover
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Main Processing
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def main
    # Make game over graphic
    @sprite = Sprite.new
    @sprite.bitmap = RPG::Cache.gameover($data_system.gameover_name)
    # Stop BGM and BGS
    $game_system.bgm_play(nil)
    $game_system.bgs_play(nil)
    # Play game over ME
    $game_system.me_play($data_system.gameover_me)
    # Execute transition
    Graphics.transition(120)
    # Main loop
    loop do
      # Update game screen
      Graphics.update
      # Update input information
      Input.update
      # Frame update
      update
      # Abort loop if screen is changed
      if $scene != self
        break
      end
    end
    # Prepare for transition
    Graphics.freeze
    # Dispose of game over graphic
    @sprite.bitmap.dispose
    @sprite.dispose
    # Execute transition
    Graphics.transition(40)
    # Prepare for transition
    Graphics.freeze
    # If battle test
    if $BTEST
      $scene = nil
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update
    # If C button was pressed
    if Input.trigger?(Input::C)
      # Switch to title screen
      $scene = Scene_Title.new
    end
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Scene_Debug
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This class performs debug screen processing.
#==============================================================================

class Scene_Debug
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Main Processing
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def main
    # Make windows
    @left_window = Window_DebugLeft.new
    @right_window = Window_DebugRight.new
    @help_window = Window_Base.new(192, 352, 448, 128)
    @help_window.contents = Bitmap.new(406, 96)
    # Restore previously selected item
    @left_window.top_row = $game_temp.debug_top_row
    @left_window.index = $game_temp.debug_index
    @right_window.mode = @left_window.mode
    @right_window.top_id = @left_window.top_id
    # Execute transition
    Graphics.transition
    # Main loop
    loop do
      # Update game screen
      Graphics.update
      # Update input information
      Input.update
      # Frame update
      update
      # Abort loop if screen is changed
      if $scene != self
        break
      end
    end
    # Refresh map
    $game_map.refresh
    # Prepare for transition
    Graphics.freeze
    # Dispose of windows
    @left_window.dispose
    @right_window.dispose
    @help_window.dispose
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update
    # Update windows
    @right_window.mode = @left_window.mode
    @right_window.top_id = @left_window.top_id
    @left_window.update
    @right_window.update
    # Memorize selected item
    $game_temp.debug_top_row = @left_window.top_row
    $game_temp.debug_index = @left_window.index
    # If left window is active: call update_left
    if @left_window.active
      update_left
      return
    end
    # If right window is active: call update_right
    if @right_window.active
      update_right
      return
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (when left window is active)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_left
    # If B button was pressed
    if Input.trigger?(Input::B)
      # Play cancel SE
      $game_system.se_play($data_system.cancel_se)
      # Switch to map screen
      $scene = Scene_Map.new
      return
    end
    # If C button was pressed
    if Input.trigger?(Input::C)
      # Play decision SE
      $game_system.se_play($data_system.decision_se)
      # Display help
      if @left_window.mode == 0
        text1 = "C (Enter) : ON / OFF"
        @help_window.contents.draw_text(4, 0, 406, 32, text1)
      else
        text1 = "Left : -1   Right : +1"
        text2 = "L (Pageup) : -10"
        text3 = "R (Pagedown) : +10"
        @help_window.contents.draw_text(4, 0, 406, 32, text1)
        @help_window.contents.draw_text(4, 32, 406, 32, text2)
        @help_window.contents.draw_text(4, 64, 406, 32, text3)
      end
      # Activate right window
      @left_window.active = false
      @right_window.active = true
      @right_window.index = 0
      return
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (when right window is active)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_right
    # If B button was pressed
    if Input.trigger?(Input::B)
      # Play cancel SE
      $game_system.se_play($data_system.cancel_se)
      # Activate left window
      @left_window.active = true
      @right_window.active = false
      @right_window.index = -1
      # Erase help
      @help_window.contents.clear
      return
    end
    # Get selected switch / variable ID
    current_id = @right_window.top_id + @right_window.index
    # If switch
    if @right_window.mode == 0
      # If C button was pressed
      if Input.trigger?(Input::C)
        # Play decision SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.decision_se)
        # Reverse ON / OFF
        $game_switches[current_id] = (not $game_switches[current_id])
        @right_window.refresh
        return
      end
    end
    # If variable
    if @right_window.mode == 1
      # If right button was pressed
      if Input.repeat?(Input::RIGHT)
        # Play cursor SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.cursor_se)
        # Increase variables by 1
        $game_variables[current_id] += 1
        # Maximum limit check
        if $game_variables[current_id] > 99999999
          $game_variables[current_id] = 99999999
        end
        @right_window.refresh
        return
      end
      # If left button was pressed
      if Input.repeat?(Input::LEFT)
        # Play cursor SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.cursor_se)
        # Decrease variables by 1
        $game_variables[current_id] -= 1
        # Minimum limit check
        if $game_variables[current_id] < -99999999
          $game_variables[current_id] = -99999999
        end
        @right_window.refresh
        return
      end
      # If R button was pressed
      if Input.repeat?(Input::R)
        # Play cursor SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.cursor_se)
        # Increase variables by 10
        $game_variables[current_id] += 10
        # Maximum limit check
        if $game_variables[current_id] > 99999999
          $game_variables[current_id] = 99999999
        end
        @right_window.refresh
        return
      end
      # If L button was pressed
      if Input.repeat?(Input::L)
        # Play cursor SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.cursor_se)
        # Decrease variables by 10
        $game_variables[current_id] -= 10
        # Minimum limit check
        if $game_variables[current_id] < -99999999
          $game_variables[current_id] = -99999999
        end
        @right_window.refresh
        return
      end
    end
  end
end

  SW_PATRULLA_CAM = 26
  SW_NOCHE2      = 27

  SW_PATRULLA_OFI = 29

#==============================================================================
# ** Interpreter - comandos para usar en "Llamar script"
#   Todos devuelven true para que el interprete no repita el comando.
#==============================================================================
class Interpreter
  def subir_veneno(n)
    Vacas.veneno = Vacas.veneno + n
    fuerza = 40 + n * 6
    fuerza = 200 if fuerza > 200
    $game_screen.start_flash(Color.new(150, 0, 0, fuerza), 12)
    $game_screen.start_shake(2 + n / 10, 8, 10 + n)
    $game_system.se_play(RPG::AudioFile.new("140-Darkness03", 70, 60))
    $vacas_hud_pulso = 40
    return true
  end
  def bajar_veneno(n)
    Vacas.veneno = Vacas.veneno - n
    $game_screen.start_flash(Color.new(200, 220, 255, 50), 20)
    $vacas_hud_pulso = 20
    return true
  end
  def veneno_al_maximo?
    return Vacas.veneno >= Vacas::VENENO_MAX
  end
  # Sube el veneno sin pasar de un tope (para escenas que no deben matar)
  def subir_veneno_tope(n, tope)
    n = tope - Vacas.veneno if Vacas.veneno + n > tope
    n = 0 if n < 0
    subir_veneno(n)
    return true
  end
  # Marca permanente: el veneno ya no baja de aqui
  def huella(n)
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_HUELLA] = n if $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_HUELLA] < n
    Vacas.veneno = Vacas.veneno
    return true
  end
  def poner_mono(si)
    nombre = si ? "vacas_steven_mono" : "vacas_steven"
    $game_actors[1].set_graphic(nombre, 0, "", 0)
    $game_player.refresh
    $game_switches[Vacas::SW_MONO] = si
    $game_map.need_refresh = true
    return true
  end
  # Paga el sueldo: monedas visibles y variables de sueldo
  def cobrar(n)
    $game_party.gain_gold(n)
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_SUELDO_HOY] += n
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_SUELDO_TOTAL] += n
    return true
  end
  # Madre se lleva el sueldo. Si guardar es true, Steven esconde una moneda.
  def entregar_sueldo(guardar)
    g = $game_party.gold
    g -= 1 if guardar and g > 0
    $game_party.lose_gold(g)
    $game_switches[Vacas::SW_SUELDO_DADO] = true
    $game_map.need_refresh = true
    return true
  end
  # Prepara el siguiente turno (al dormir)
  def nuevo_turno
    for i in [Vacas::SW_FICHADO, Vacas::SW_MONO, Vacas::SW_PATRULLA_CAM, Vacas::SW_NOCHE2,
              Vacas::SW_SUELDO_DADO, Vacas::SW_PATRULLA_OFI, Vacas::SW_ESCONDIDO2,
              Vacas::SW_PILLADO_CRIPPS, Vacas::SW_PIEZA]
      $game_switches[i] = false
    end
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_TURNO] += 1
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_FASE] = 0
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_SUELDO_HOY] = 0
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_PIEZAS] = 0
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_PIEZA] = 0
    $game_switches[Vacas::SW_MATADERO] = true
    $game_switches[Vacas::SW_TURNO3] = ($game_variables[Vacas::VAR_TURNO] == 3)
    $game_map.need_refresh = true
    return true
  end
  # Perro: una caricia que cura, una vez por noche
  def perro_esta_noche?
    return $game_variables[17] < $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_TURNO]
  end
  def perro_hecho
    $game_variables[17] = $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_TURNO]
    return true
  end
  def fase(n)
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_FASE] = n
    $game_map.need_refresh = true
    return true
  end
  def fin_del_acto
    $scene = Scene_FinActo.new(1)
    return true
  end
  def fin_del_acto2
    $scene = Scene_FinActo.new(2)
    return true
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Vacas - Veneno (cordura)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Indicador discreto en pantalla y efectos (tono, temblor, destellos)
#  que crecen con la variable 1 "Veneno" (0..100).
#==============================================================================

$vacas_hud_pulso = 0

class Sprite_Veneno < Sprite
  ANCHO = 96
  def initialize
    super(nil)
    self.bitmap = Bitmap.new(ANCHO + 8, 22)
    self.x = 14
    self.y = 480 - 34
    self.z = 4000
    @valor = -1
    @contador = 0
    refrescar
  end
  def dispose
    self.bitmap.dispose if self.bitmap != nil
    super
  end
  def refrescar
    v = Vacas.veneno
    @valor = v
    b = self.bitmap
    b.clear
    b.font.size = 13
    b.font.color = Color.new(190, 170, 140, 255)
    b.draw_text(0, 0, ANCHO, 12, "veneno")
    # marco
    b.fill_rect(0, 14, ANCHO, 6, Color.new(0, 0, 0, 200))
    b.fill_rect(1, 15, ANCHO - 2, 4, Color.new(40, 32, 26, 220))
    largo = (ANCHO - 2) * v / Vacas::VENENO_MAX
    if largo > 0
      r = 150 + v
      r = 255 if r > 255
      g = 120 - v
      g = 10 if g < 10
      b.fill_rect(1, 15, largo, 4, Color.new(r, g, 20, 255))
    end
  end
  def update
    super
    refrescar if @valor != Vacas.veneno
    oculto = ($game_switches != nil and $game_switches[Vacas::SW_HUD_OCULTO])
    @contador += 1
    base = 110 + Vacas.veneno
    if Vacas.veneno >= 50
      # latido: mas rapido cuanto mas veneno
      periodo = 70 - Vacas.veneno / 2
      periodo = 20 if periodo < 20
      base += 50 if (@contador % periodo) < 6
    end
    if $vacas_hud_pulso > 0
      $vacas_hud_pulso -= 1
      base = 255 if ($vacas_hud_pulso / 4) % 2 == 0
    end
    base = 255 if base > 255
    if oculto
      self.opacity = 0
    else
      self.opacity = base
    end
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Spriteset_Map - tono extra y efectos aleatorios segun el veneno
#==============================================================================
class Spriteset_Map
  alias vacas_ssm_initialize initialize
  def initialize
    @vacas_hud = Sprite_Veneno.new
    vacas_ssm_initialize
  end
  alias vacas_ssm_dispose dispose
  def dispose
    @vacas_hud.dispose
    vacas_ssm_dispose
  end
  alias vacas_ssm_update update
  def update
    vacas_ssm_update
    return if @vacas_hud == nil
    @vacas_hud.update
    v = Vacas.veneno
    t = $game_screen.tone
    # el veneno amarillea, apaga el azul y quita color
    rr = t.red + v * 0.30
    gg = t.green - v * 0.15
    bb = t.blue - v * 0.45
    gr = t.gray + v * 1.4
    gr = 255 if gr > 255
    @viewport1.tone = Tone.new(rr, gg, bb, gr)
    vacas_efectos(v)
  end
  def vacas_efectos(v)
    return if $game_switches[Vacas::SW_SIN_EFECTOS]
    return if $game_temp.message_window_showing
    if v >= 35 and rand(900 - v * 6) == 0
      $game_screen.start_shake(1 + v / 35, 5, 6 + v / 10)
    end
    if v >= 55 and rand(1100 - v * 8) == 0
      $game_screen.start_flash(Color.new(120, 0, 0, 30 + v), 4 + v / 12)
    end
    if v >= 75 and rand(1600 - v * 10) == 0
      $game_system.se_play(RPG::AudioFile.new("040-Knock01", 60, 70))
      $game_screen.start_flash(Color.new(0, 0, 0, 160), 10)
    end
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Vacas - Menu de terror
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Menu reducido: Objetos / Guardar (solo con la tele) / Salir, con una
#  lista de tareas pendientes. Sin estado, equipo ni habilidades.
#==============================================================================

module Vacas
  # Devuelve [[texto, hecho], ...] segun los interruptores de la historia
  def self.tareas
    s = $game_switches
    lista = []
    return tareas_acto2 if s[22]
    if s[14]
      lista.push(["Ya tienes trabajo.", true])
    elsif s[13]
      lista.push(["Bajar a la calle: el camión del matadero.", false])
    elsif s[10]
      lista.push(["Esconderte. Ya viene.", false])
    elsif s[9]
      lista.push(["Ir a dormir.", false])
    elsif s[2]
      lista.push(["Dar de comer a Perro.", s[3]])
      lista.push(["Llevarle el jarabe a madre.", s[4]])
      lista.push(["Comprar carne en la carnicería.", s[5]])
      lista.push(["Darle la carne a madre.", s[6]])
      lista.push(["Leer los anuncios del portal.", s[7]])
      if s[3] and s[4] and s[6] and s[7]
        lista.push(["Volver con madre.", false])
      end
    else
      lista.push(["Ir a ver qué quiere madre.", false])
    end
    return lista
  end
  # Acto II: segun turno (variable 7) y fase (variable 8)
  def self.tareas_acto2
    s = $game_switches
    t = $game_variables[7]
    f = $game_variables[8]
    lista = []
    if s[27]
      lista.push(["Volver a casa: el 3ºB.", false]) if $game_map.map_id == 3 and !s[28]
      lista.push(["Darle el sueldo a madre.", s[28]])
      lista.push(["Acostarte. Mañana hay turno.", false]) if s[28]
      return lista
    end
    lista.push(["Fichar a la entrada.", s[24]])
    lista.push(["Ponerte el mono en el vestuario.", s[25]]) if s[24]
    return lista unless s[25]
    case t
    when 1
      lista.push(["La cadena: el puesto de la cinta.", f > 3])
      lista.push(["Traer la manguera del pasillo de mantenimiento.", f > 4]) if f >= 4
      lista.push(["Devolverle la manguera a Cripps.", f > 5]) if f >= 5
    when 2
      lista.push(["La cadena: el puesto de corte.", f > 3])
      lista.push(["Llevar piezas a las cámaras (" + $game_variables[13].to_s + "/3).", f > 4]) if f >= 4
      lista.push(["La rejilla del pasillo de mantenimiento.", f > 5]) if f >= 5
      lista.push(["El libro de Cripps, en su oficina.", f > 6]) if f >= 6
      lista.push(["Volver a la rejilla.", f > 7]) if f >= 7
    when 3
      lista.push(["Hablar con Cripps en la cadena.", f > 3])
      lista.push(["Traer la vaca del corral del fondo.", f > 4]) if f >= 4
      lista.push(["El cajón.", f > 5]) if f >= 5
    end
    lista.push(["Fichar la salida.", false]) if f >= 9
    return lista
  end
end

    $game_system = Game_System.new
    @sprite = Sprite.new
    @sprite.bitmap = RPG::Cache.title($data_system.title_name)
    @command_window = Window_Command.new(200, ["Nueva partida", "Continuar", "Salir"])
    @command_window.back_opacity = 140
    @command_window.x = 320 - @command_window.width / 2
    @command_window.y = 350
    @continue_enabled = false
    for i in 0..3
      if FileTest.exist?("Save#{i+1}.rxdata")
        @continue_enabled = true
      end
    end
    if @continue_enabled
      @command_window.index = 1
    else
      @command_window.disable_item(1)
    end
    $game_system.bgm_play($data_system.title_bgm)
    Audio.me_stop
    Audio.bgs_stop
    Graphics.transition(40)
    loop do
      Graphics.update
      Input.update
      update
      break if $scene != self
    end
    Graphics.freeze
    @command_window.dispose
    @sprite.bitmap.dispose
    @sprite.dispose
  end
end

# ** Scene_FinActo - "Fin del Acto I / II"
#   Acto 1: al pulsar Intro sigue en el Acto II (misma partida).
#   Acto 2: vuelve al titulo.
#==============================================================================
class Scene_FinActo
  TEXTOS = {
    1 => ["Fin del Acto I", "El piso", "Acto II: La cadena", "Pulsa Intro para seguir"],
    2 => ["Fin del Acto II", "La cadena", "Acto III: Lucy", "Pulsa Intro para seguir"],
    3 => ["Fin del Acto III", "Lucy", "Continuará en el Acto IV: Bajo la ciudad", "Pulsa Intro para volver al título"]
  }
  def initialize(acto = 1)
    @acto = acto
  end
  def main
    Audio.bgm_fade(2000)
    Audio.bgs_fade(2000)
    t = TEXTOS[@acto]
    @fondo = Sprite.new
    @fondo.bitmap = Bitmap.new(640, 480)
    @fondo.bitmap.fill_rect(0, 0, 640, 480, Color.new(0, 0, 0))
    @fin = Vacas.sprite_texto([t[0]], 170, 50, 40, Color.new(170, 30, 26))
    @sub = Vacas.sprite_texto([t[1]], 224, 32, 22)
    @sig = Vacas.sprite_texto([t[2]], 330, 28, 18, Color.new(140, 130, 115))
    @pie = Vacas.sprite_texto([t[3]], 420, 24, 14, Color.new(110, 100, 90))
    for s in [@fin, @sub, @sig, @pie]
      s.opacity = 0
    end
    Graphics.transition(60)
    $game_system.me_play(RPG::AudioFile.new("015-Mystery01", 80, 70))
    @t = 0
    loop do
      Graphics.update
      Input.update
      @t += 1
      @fin.opacity = (@t - 20) * 3 if @t > 20
      @sub.opacity = (@t - 100) * 3 if @t > 100
      @sig.opacity = (@t - 200) * 2 if @t > 200
      @pie.opacity = 60 + (@t % 80) * 2 if @t > 260
      if @t > 260 and Input.trigger?(Input::C)
        if @acto == 1
          Vacas.empezar_acto2
          $scene = Scene_Map.new
        elsif @acto == 2
          Vacas.empezar_acto3
          $scene = Scene_Map.new
        else
          $scene = Scene_Title.new
        end
      end
      break if $scene != self
    end
    Graphics.freeze
    for s in [@fondo, @fin, @sub, @sig, @pie]
      s.bitmap.dispose
      s.dispose
    end
    Graphics.transition(60)
    Graphics.freeze
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Vacas - Matadero (Acto II)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Minijuegos de trabajo (el corte y la cinta), vigilancia de Cripps y
#  escondites. Se llaman desde eventos con "Llamar script":
#    minijuego_corte(rondas)   -> resultado en la variable 12 (aciertos)
#    minijuego_cinta(piezas)   -> resultado en la variable 12 (aciertos)
#  Compatible con RGSS1 (Ruby 1.8).
#==============================================================================

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Base comun: capa oscura encima del mapa, textos y espera
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Vacas_Minijuego
  def initialize
    @vp = Viewport.new(0, 0, 640, 480)
    @vp.z = 6000
    @sprites = []
    @fondo = nuevo_sprite(640, 480)
    @fondo.bitmap.fill_rect(0, 0, 640, 480, Color.new(6, 4, 4, 200))
  end
  def nuevo_sprite(w, h)
    s = Sprite.new(@vp)
    s.bitmap = Bitmap.new(w, h)
    @sprites.push(s)
    return s
  end
  def texto(s, y, tam, color, h = 32)
    sp = nuevo_sprite(640, h)
    sp.y = y
    sp.bitmap.font.size = tam
    sp.bitmap.font.color = color
    sp.bitmap.draw_text(0, 0, 640, h, s, 1)
    return sp
  end
  def rotulo(sp, s, color)
    sp.bitmap.clear
    sp.bitmap.font.color = color
    sp.bitmap.draw_text(0, 0, 640, sp.bitmap.height, s, 1)
  end
  def esperar(n)
    n.times do
      tick
    end
  end
  def tick
    Graphics.update
    Input.update
    @vp.update
  end
  def se(nombre, vol = 80, tono = 100)
    $game_system.se_play(RPG::AudioFile.new(nombre, vol, tono))
  end
  def veneno
    return Vacas.veneno
  end
  def dispose
    for s in @sprites
      s.bitmap.dispose
      s.dispose
    end
    @vp.dispose
  end
  CLARO = Color.new(214, 204, 186)
  GRIS  = Color.new(140, 130, 118)
  ROJO  = Color.new(190, 36, 30)
  OSCURO = Color.new(60, 10, 10)
end

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# El corte: una cuchilla va y viene por una barra. Hay que soltarla
# (Intro) cuando cruza la franja roja. La franja se estrecha.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Vacas_Corte < Vacas_Minijuego
  BX = 120
  BW = 400
  BY = 330
  def initialize(rondas)
    super()
    @rondas = rondas
    texto("EL CORTE", 26, 26, ROJO, 36)
    texto("Pulsa Intro cuando la cuchilla cruce la franja roja.", 62, 18, GRIS)
    @canal = nuevo_sprite(160, 220)
    @canal.x = 240
    @canal.y = 92
    dibujar_canal(0)
    @barra = nuevo_sprite(BW + 8, 32)
    @barra.x = BX - 4
    @barra.y = BY
    @cuchilla = nuevo_sprite(6, 44)
    @cuchilla.bitmap.fill_rect(0, 0, 6, 44, Color.new(230, 232, 236))
    @cuchilla.bitmap.fill_rect(2, 0, 2, 44, Color.new(120, 124, 130))
    @cuchilla.y = BY - 6
    @info = texto("", 380, 22, CLARO)
    @cuenta = texto("", 420, 18, GRIS)
  end
  def dibujar_canal(cortes)
    b = @canal.bitmap
    b.clear
    b.fill_rect(76, 0, 8, 20, Color.new(150, 156, 162))
    b.fill_rect(30, 20, 100, 190, Color.new(30, 6, 6))
    b.fill_rect(34, 24, 92, 182, Color.new(140, 48, 44))
    b.fill_rect(46, 30, 68, 170, Color.new(168, 74, 64))
    y = 40
    while y < 196
      b.fill_rect(48, y, 64, 3, Color.new(214, 196, 170))
      y += 14
    end
    b.fill_rect(78, 24, 4, 182, Color.new(96, 26, 24))
    for i in 0...cortes
      yy = 40 + i * 26
      b.fill_rect(20, yy, 120, 2, Color.new(20, 0, 0))
    end
  end
  def nueva_franja(r)
    ancho = 70 - r * 8
    ancho = 26 if ancho < 26
    @zona_w = ancho
    @zona_x = 20 + rand(BW - ancho - 40)
    b = @barra.bitmap
    b.clear
    b.fill_rect(0, 0, BW + 8, 32, Color.new(0, 0, 0))
    b.fill_rect(4, 4, BW, 24, Color.new(70, 66, 62))
    b.fill_rect(4 + @zona_x, 4, @zona_w, 24, Color.new(150, 24, 20))
    b.fill_rect(4 + @zona_x + @zona_w / 2 - 1, 4, 2, 24, Color.new(220, 120, 110))
  end
  def run
    aciertos = 0
    esperar(30)
    for r in 0...@rondas
      nueva_franja(r)
      rotulo(@cuenta, "Pieza " + (r + 1).to_s + " de " + @rondas.to_s, GRIS)
      rotulo(@info, "", CLARO)
      pos = 0.0
      vel = 4.0 + r * 0.9
      dir = 1
      marco = 0
      soltado = false
      while marco < 360
        tick
        marco += 1
        pos += vel * dir
        if pos >= BW - 2
          pos = BW - 2
          dir = -1
        elsif pos <= 0
          pos = 0
          dir = 1
        end
        temblor = 0
        temblor = rand(5) - 2 if veneno >= 50 and rand(6) == 0
        @cuchilla.x = BX + pos.to_i - 3 + temblor
        # alucinacion: la canal respira
        if veneno >= 40 and marco % 90 < 10
          @canal.zoom_x = 1.0 + (marco % 90) * 0.004
        else
          @canal.zoom_x = 1.0
        end
        if Input.trigger?(Input::C)
          soltado = true
          break
        end
      end
      centro = pos - @zona_x
      if soltado and centro >= 0 and centro <= @zona_w
        aciertos += 1
        se("093-Attack05", 80, 70)
        @vp.flash(Color.new(120, 0, 0, 90), 6)
        rotulo(@info, "Limpio.", CLARO)
      else
        se("057-Wrong01", 70, 80)
        @vp.flash(Color.new(0, 0, 0, 200), 10)
        rotulo(@info, soltado ? "Torcido. Se ha astillado el hueso." : "Demasiado lento.", ROJO)
      end
      dibujar_canal(aciertos)
      esperar(40)
    end
    rotulo(@cuenta, "", GRIS)
    rotulo(@info, "Cortes limpios: " + aciertos.to_s + " de " + @rondas.to_s, CLARO)
    esperar(70)
    return aciertos
  end
end

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# La cinta: piezas que llegan por la derecha con una flecha. Pulsa esa
# direccion cuando la pieza esta dentro del recuadro. La cinta acelera.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Vacas_Cinta < Vacas_Minijuego
  ZX = 90
  ZW = 70
  CY = 250
  DIRS = [2, 4, 6, 8]
  def initialize(piezas)
    super()
    @total = piezas
    texto("LA CINTA", 26, 26, ROJO, 36)
    texto("Pulsa la flecha de cada pieza cuando entre en el recuadro.", 62, 18, GRIS)
    @cinta = nuevo_sprite(640, 80)
    @cinta.y = CY - 10
    @cinta_off = 0
    @zona = nuevo_sprite(ZW, 76)
    @zona.x = ZX
    @zona.y = CY - 8
    pintar_zona(Color.new(200, 190, 170))
    @info = texto("", 360, 22, CLARO)
    @cuenta = texto("", 400, 18, GRIS)
    @piezas = []
  end
  def pintar_zona(c)
    b = @zona.bitmap
    b.clear
    b.fill_rect(0, 0, ZW, 3, c)
    b.fill_rect(0, 73, ZW, 3, c)
    b.fill_rect(0, 0, 3, 76, c)
    b.fill_rect(ZW - 3, 0, 3, 76, c)
  end
  def pintar_cinta
    b = @cinta.bitmap
    b.clear
    b.fill_rect(0, 0, 640, 60, Color.new(20, 20, 22))
    b.fill_rect(0, 4, 640, 52, Color.new(52, 52, 54))
    x = -(@cinta_off % 24)
    while x < 640
      b.fill_rect(x, 4, 2, 52, Color.new(82, 82, 84))
      x += 24
    end
  end
  def flecha(b, d, cx, cy, c)
    for i in 0...10
      case d
      when 8 then b.fill_rect(cx - i, cy - 8 + i, i * 2 + 1, 1, c)
      when 2 then b.fill_rect(cx - i, cy + 8 - i, i * 2 + 1, 1, c)
      when 4 then b.fill_rect(cx - 8 + i, cy - i, 1, i * 2 + 1, c)
      when 6 then b.fill_rect(cx + 8 - i, cy - i, 1, i * 2 + 1, c)
      end
    end
  end
  def nueva_pieza
    s = nuevo_sprite(48, 48)
    d = DIRS[rand(4)]
    b = s.bitmap
    b.fill_rect(2, 6, 44, 36, Color.new(30, 6, 6))
    b.fill_rect(4, 8, 40, 32, Color.new(150, 52, 46))
    b.fill_rect(6, 12, 36, 4, Color.new(214, 196, 170))
    flecha(b, d, 24, 26, Color.new(240, 236, 226))
    s.x = 640
    s.y = CY
    @piezas.push([s, d, false])
  end
  def run
    aciertos = 0
    lanzadas = 0
    espera = 0
    vel = 3.0
    esperar(30)
    loop do
      tick
      @cinta_off += vel.to_i
      pintar_cinta
      espera -= 1
      if lanzadas < @total and espera <= 0
        nueva_pieza
        lanzadas += 1
        espera = 70 - lanzadas * 3
        espera = 34 if espera < 34
        vel += 0.25
      end
      pulsada = Input.dir4
      pulsada = 0 unless Input.trigger?(Input::DOWN) or Input.trigger?(Input::LEFT) or
                         Input.trigger?(Input::RIGHT) or Input.trigger?(Input::UP)
      # pieza mas adelantada todavia viva
      primera = nil
      for p in @piezas
        next if p[2]
        primera = p
        break
      end
      if pulsada != 0 and primera != nil
        dentro = primera[0].x + 24 >= ZX and primera[0].x + 24 <= ZX + ZW
        if dentro and pulsada == primera[1]
          aciertos += 1
          primera[2] = true
          primera[0].visible = false
          se("093-Attack05", 70, 90)
          pintar_zona(Color.new(220, 60, 50))
          rotulo(@info, "Bien.", CLARO)
        else
          se("057-Wrong01", 60, 80)
          @vp.flash(Color.new(120, 0, 0, 80), 6)
          primera[2] = true
          primera[0].opacity = 90
          rotulo(@info, "¡Esa no!", ROJO)
        end
      end
      for p in @piezas
        p[0].x -= vel.to_i
        if !p[2] and p[0].x + 24 < ZX
          p[2] = true
          p[0].opacity = 90
          se("057-Wrong01", 50, 70)
          rotulo(@info, "Se te ha escapado una.", ROJO)
        end
        if p[0].x < -48 and p[0].visible
          p[0].visible = false
        end
      end
      pintar_zona(Color.new(200, 190, 170)) if Graphics.frame_count % 12 == 0
      if veneno >= 45 and rand(240) == 0
        @vp.flash(Color.new(0, 0, 0, 160), 8)
      end
      rotulo(@cuenta, "Piezas: " + aciertos.to_s + " / " + @total.to_s, GRIS) if Graphics.frame_count % 10 == 0
      terminado = (lanzadas >= @total)
      for p in @piezas
        terminado = false if p[0].x > -48 and p[0].visible
      end
      break if terminado
    end
    rotulo(@info, "La cinta se para. Piezas a tiempo: " + aciertos.to_s + " de " + @total.to_s, CLARO)
    esperar(70)
    return aciertos
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Vigilancia de Cripps
#   Los eventos llamados "Cripps vigila" ven en linea recta hacia donde
#   miran (5 casillas) y notan al jugador pegado a ellos. Las paredes y las
#   canales colgadas tapan la vista. Escondido, no te ven.
#==============================================================================
class Game_Event
  def vacas_vigia?
    return false if @erased or @character_name == "" or @transparent or @opacity == 0
    return @event.name == "Cripps vigila"
  end
  def vacas_tapa?(x, y)
    for ev in $game_map.events.values
      next if ev == self or ev.through
      next if ev.character_name == ""
      return true if ev.x == x and ev.y == y
    end
    return false
  end
  def vacas_ve_al_jugador?
    px = $game_player.x
    py = $game_player.y
    dx = px - @x
    dy = py - @y
    return true if dx.abs + dy.abs <= 1
    rango = 5
    case @direction
    when 2 then return false unless dx == 0 and dy > 0 and dy <= rango
    when 8 then return false unless dx == 0 and dy < 0 and -dy <= rango
    when 6 then return false unless dy == 0 and dx > 0 and dx <= rango
    when 4 then return false unless dy == 0 and dx < 0 and -dx <= rango
    else return false
    end
    sx = (dx <=> 0)
    sy = (dy <=> 0)
    x = @x + sx
    y = @y + sy
    while x != px or y != py
      return false unless $game_map.passable?(x, y, 0)
      return false if vacas_tapa?(x, y)
      x += sx
      y += sy
    end
    return true
  end
end

class Game_Map
  alias vacas_gm_update update
  def update
    vacas_gm_update
    vacas_vigilar
  end
  def vacas_vigilar
    return unless $game_switches[Vacas::SW_PATRULLA_CAM] or $game_switches[Vacas::SW_PATRULLA_OFI]
    return if $game_switches[Vacas::SW_ESCONDIDO2] or $game_switches[Vacas::SW_PILLADO_CRIPPS]
    return if $game_system.map_interpreter.running? or $game_temp.message_window_showing
    for ev in @events.values
      next unless ev.vacas_vigia?
      if ev.vacas_ve_al_jugador?
        $game_switches[Vacas::SW_PILLADO_CRIPPS] = true
        @need_refresh = true
        $game_screen.start_flash(Color.new(255, 0, 0, 160), 10)
        $game_system.se_play(RPG::AudioFile.new("092-Attack04", 90, 60))
        return
      end
    end
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Escondites: mientras el interruptor 30 esta activo, Steven no se mueve;
#    cualquier direccion o Intro le hace salir del escondite.
#==============================================================================
class Game_Player
  alias vacas_gp_update update
  def update
    if $game_switches[Vacas::SW_ESCONDIDO2] and !moving? and
       !$game_system.map_interpreter.running? and !$game_temp.message_window_showing and
       !@move_route_forcing
      if Input.dir4 != 0 or Input.trigger?(Input::C)
        $game_switches[Vacas::SW_ESCONDIDO2] = false
        @opacity = 255
        $game_map.need_refresh = true
        $game_system.se_play(RPG::AudioFile.new("045-Push01", 50, 120))
      end
      return
    end
    vacas_gp_update
  end
  def vacas_esconder
    $game_switches[Vacas::SW_ESCONDIDO2] = true
    @opacity = 90
    $game_map.need_refresh = true
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# Vacas_Mente -- Combate frontal XP. Enemigos mentales; veneno nunca mata aqui.
#==============================================================================
module Vacas
  def self.preparar_mente(completo = false)
    for a in $game_party.actors
      # Tambien migra partidas anteriores sin reiniciar sus estadisticas.
      for id in [61, 62, 63, 64]
        a.learn_skill(id)
      end
      a.set_graphic(a.character_name, a.character_hue, 'steven_mente', 0)
      if completo
        a.recover_all
      else
        a.hp = [a.hp, a.maxhp * 3 / 4].max
        a.sp = [a.sp, a.maxsp * 3 / 4].max
      end
    end
  end
end
class Interpreter
  def preparar_mente
    Vacas.preparar_mente(true)
    return true
  end
end
class Scene_Map
  alias vacas_mente_call_battle call_battle
  def call_battle
    # Los encuentros aleatorios se limitan a estos mapas y fuera de patrullas.
    if $game_temp.battle_proc == nil
      unless Vacas.veneno >= 35 and [8, 9, 11].include?($game_map.map_id) and
          !$game_switches[26] and !$game_switches[29] and !$game_switches[30]
        $game_temp.battle_calling = false
        $game_player.make_encounter_count
        return
      end
      $game_temp.battle_can_lose = true
      $game_system.vacas_gastar_encuentro
    end
    Vacas.preparar_mente(false)
    $vacas_tone_antes = $game_screen.tone.clone
    $vacas_fondo_antes = $game_map.battleback_name
    troop = $game_temp.battle_troop_id
    fondo = [2, 8].include?(troop) ? 'piso' : ([3, 6].include?(troop) ? 'tunel' : 'matadero')
    $game_map.battleback_name = 'mente_' + fondo
    $game_screen.start_tone_change(Tone.new(-15, -20, -12, 45), 0)
    vacas_mente_call_battle
  end
end
class Game_Battler
  alias vacas_mente_skill_effect skill_effect
  def skill_effect(user, skill)
    effective = vacas_mente_skill_effect(user, skill)
    if $game_temp.in_battle and self.is_a?(Game_Actor)
      if user.is_a?(Game_Enemy) and effective
        extra = {65=>4, 66=>5, 67=>6, 68=>4, 69=>3, 70=>7}[skill.id]
        Vacas.veneno = [96, Vacas.veneno + extra].min if extra != nil
      elsif skill.id == 61
        self.sp += 18
        for id in [2, 3, 4]
          remove_state(id)
        end
        Vacas.veneno = Vacas.veneno - 6
        effective = true
      end
    end
    return effective
  end
end
class Scene_Battle
  alias vacas_mente_start_phase2 start_phase2
  def start_phase2
    # Solo un pequeño aumento por ronda, sin alcanzar el game over de historia.
    if $game_temp.battle_turn > 0
      burden = $game_party.actors.any? { |a| a.state?(4) } ? 2 : 1
      Vacas.veneno = [96, Vacas.veneno + burden].min
    end
    vacas_mente_start_phase2
  end
  alias vacas_mente_end battle_end
  def battle_end(result)
    $game_variables[18] = result
    Vacas.veneno = result == 0 ? Vacas.veneno - 5 : [96, Vacas.veneno + 8].min
    # No se mantienen muerte ni estados mentales fuera de estas visiones.

module Vacas
  def self.empezar_acto3
    return unless $game_switches[34]
    $game_switches[81] = true
    for id in [9,10,11,15,16,23,24,25,26,27,29,30,31,40]
      $game_switches[id] = false

    $game_temp.player_new_map_id = 12
    $game_temp.player_new_x = 12
    $game_temp.player_new_y = 17
    $game_temp.player_new_direction = 8
    $game_temp.player_transferring = true
    $game_temp.transition_processing = false
  end
  def self.prueba_acto3(resistir = false)
    prueba_acto2
    for id in [28,34,39,43,55]
      $game_switches[id] = true
    end
    $game_switches[35] = !resistir
    $game_switches[36] = resistir
    $game_variables[7] = 3
    $game_variables[8] = 9
    $game_variables[15] = resistir ? 25 : 35
    self.veneno = 40
    $game_party.gain_item(13,1)
    empezar_acto3
    $game_temp.player_transferring = false
    $game_map.setup(12)
    $game_player.moveto(12,17)
    $game_player.turn_up
    $game_map.autoplay
    $game_map.update
  end
  class << self
    alias lucy_tareas_anteriores tareas
    def tareas
      return lucy_tareas_anteriores unless $game_switches[81]
      s = $game_switches
      return [["Acto IV: el colector espera.",false]] if s[98]
      return [["Hablar con Lucy en el laboratorio.",false]] if s[88]
      return [["Comparar las dos muestras y el control.",false]] if s[86]
      return [["Hospital: pedir material a Elena.",false]] if s[85]
      return [["Depósito: riñón del lote sin etiqueta.",false]] if s[84]
      return [["Carnicería: hígado y sal para el control.",false]] if s[83]
      return [["Hablar con Lucy, junto a su mesa.",false]]
    end
  end
end

begin
  # Prepare for transition
  Graphics.freeze
  # Make scene object (title screen)
  $scene = Scene_Aviso.new
  # Call main method as long as $scene is effective
  while $scene != nil

  print("Unable to find file #{filename}.")
